svg.title: MagicPilot LIVE PRO view, labelled
svg.desc: The Tab5 in the PRO view over the camera's live HDMI picture, with each part of the screen labelled: FPS, shutter and iris; timecode; ISO, white balance and tint; settings; CAM power; M5 Tab power; the live picture; the PRO buttons; the slate; codec and quality; presets; record and play; card slots; focus; autofocus.
